verdict.rationale: Luma's own marketing introduces "Luma Skills: Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever" and describes agents that research, generate, and refine across media. That points to reusable, agent-driven creative workflows, but nothing shows they run autonomously in the background on schedules or triggers. The developer API is a building block, not the automation capability itself, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented background or scheduled execution, trigger or event-based automation setup, monitoring and notification of unattended runs, in-depth docs on Skills, independent or hands-on corroboration.
